svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Autonomous Delegation — control and information flow
svg.desc: The user states intent to Main. Main freezes a revisioned task contract, launches exactly one background Supervisor with TASK_ASSIGNMENT, sends it its own agent ID, and then stops routine execution, review and supervision. The Supervisor issues EXECUTION_ORDER to one active-writer Executor (additional executors only for justified independent or verification work). Executors report progress, decisions and problems in EXECUTION_UPDATE to the Supervisor only, and return EXECUTION_RESULT or EXECUTION_BLOCKED. The Supervisor reports its own checks and decisions, and the Executor news worth knowing, to Main. The Supervisor independently verifies each mandatory acceptance criterion in the VERIFYING state; a failure resumes the same Executor with concrete failed checks and then rechecks. The Supervisor reports to Main: TASK_ACCEPTED, PROGRESS_REPORT, DECISION_REQUEST and TASK_COMPLETED, TASK_BLOCKED or TASK_FAILED. The terminal report reaches Main as the Supervisor's handback, and undelivered information is never claimed as delivered. Unknown is never treated as pass; only independently verified criteria yield COMPLETED.

g.text: Main delegates once · one background Supervisor runs the management loop · Executors do the work · progress, decisions and problems are reported as they happen
Supervisor, then sends it its agent ID
A status question is not a takeover.
Never infers COMPLETED from an exit.
exactly one · background · owns the outcome
• Reads every protocol file before acting
• One active writer per shared resource
Fail → resume the SAME Executor with
A check is never weakened to pass.
• Intervenes only on evidence; no polling
• Stops on deviation, risk or retry limit
(result also written to the result location)
Cannot change contract or claim acceptance
Handback — the final or blocked report
The terminal report reaches Main as the Supervisor's handback. Undelivered critical information is recorded as undelivered — never claimed as delivered.
Without a live message channel, everything due to Main travels in it, so the report is always complete and self-contained.
Terminal means: COMPLETED = all mandatory criteria independently verified · FAILED / CANCELLED close only this run · a retry is a new, explicitly authorized run.
UNKNOWN means observability lost — reconcile before acting; silence is never evidence of completion, failure, or cancellation.
